    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.extended_brick_endomorphisms_commute (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Finite k] (S : FGModuleCat R) (hs : IsBrick S) (f g : extendObj k F R S ⟶ extendObj k F R S) :
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g f

    The endomorphism algebra of an extended ground brick over a finite ground field remains commutative after any scalar extension.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.finite_galois_constituents (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsGalois k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [Finite k] (P : TwoTerm R) (S : FGModuleCat R) (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)), Nonempty (extendObj k F R S ≅ ⨁ B) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable (B i)) ∧ Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B) ∧ (∀ (Y : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable Y → ((∃ (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R Y), f ≠ 0) ↔ ∃ (i : Fin n), Nonempty (Y ≅ B i))) ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin n), ∃ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (v : restrictObj k F R (B i) ⟶ restrictObj k F R (B j)), IsGaloisHom k F R σ v ∧ Function.Bijective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom v.hom)

    A stable module over a finite ground field extends to a multiplicity-free sum of stable modules forming one Galois orbit. The summands are exactly the stable extension modules whose restrictions admit a nonzero map from S.
